# A hand-written sample of the `launchctl print` format, to be replaced by output captured on a
# device.
system/dev.hostkeeper.hostkeeper = {
	active count = 1
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/dev.hostkeeper.hostkeeper.plist
	state = running

	program = /usr/local/bin/hostkeeper
	arguments = {
		/usr/local/bin/hostkeeper
		daemon
	}

	pid = 4242
	last exit code = (never exited)
}
